Introduction

RIAAN, born in 2003, is a soloist under Nostalgiaa Records. He is currently majoring in Vocal Performance at the Seoul Institute of the Arts’ Department of Practical Music. Proficient in various instruments, including piano and guitar, he has developed exceptional vocal skills and dance performance abilities through years of training.
He took his first step as a global artist with the release of his debut single “Treat Me Better” on July 30, 2024.
